planner_capacity_policy.target_open_focused_work_issues: 45-55 when legitimate approved scope supports it
planner_capacity_policy.target_immediately_eligible_unclaimed: >=10 when legitimate dependencies and scope permit
planner_capacity_policy.current_priority: Current and earlier unresolved active work always outranks dependency-blocked future work.
planner_capacity_policy.future_predecomposition: README/ROADMAP-defined near-future work may be pre-decomposed only when useful for capacity and must remain explicitly blocked until its phase/dependencies are eligible.
planner_capacity_policy.parallelism: Maintain useful Coder and Designer parallelism when legitimate approved work permits.
planner_capacity_policy.anti_filler: Never invent features/gameplay, duplicate existing scope, split into artificial micro-tasks, or create filler merely to satisfy an issue-count target.

core_rule: Player advises -> AI Character decides -> Simulation validates -> World reacts.

baseline.public_policy: Normal independently verified status requires an independent Tester; cumulative deadlock may use accurately labeled DEADLOCK TESTER PASS only under README conditions.

phase_policy.origin_rule: Every new campaign begins at authoritative world coordinate (0,0) in the SEED-generated inhabited starting village.
phase_policy.map_rule: The living strategic map is the primary playable surface; the visible region is only a local active part of the larger continuous unbounded world.
phase_policy.world_generation_rule: Compatible SEED + world coordinates + compatible generator rules reproduce the same unmodified base world and coherent spatial/political relationships.
phase_policy.region_size_rule: README: one normal logical/thematic region is exactly 100x100 tiles. Existing 80x80 active-map default/max and incompatible legacy region-size assumptions must be reconciled to that single logical contract without creating a finite world boundary.
phase_policy.region_theme_rule: README: each 100x100 region has a deterministic coherent theme from SEED + world coordinates + compatible rules; large cities may occupy a coherent deterministic 2x2 footprint of four adjacent 100x100 regions under one settlement identity.
phase_policy.starter_spatial_layout_rule: README: the origin starter village distributes deterministic SEED-derived buildings, roads/paths, homes, workplaces, services, landmarks and NPC assignments across the full 100x100 region. Incompatible building footprints do not overlap; representative starter homes are at least 10x10 tiles with at least two logical rooms and connect logically to roads/paths.
phase_policy.npc_tile_occupancy_rule: README: gameplay-relevant active NPCs use unique authoritative integer logical tiles per movement step. Deterministic conflicts support priority plus yield/wait/available-neighbor side-step; direct NPC-to-NPC dialogue uses adjacent tiles, never the same tile.
phase_policy.development_activity_bubble_rule: README: during development each active NPC may show a small readable activity bubble; an NPC conversation uses one combined bubble for the pair. Bubbles are presentation/debug only and never Simulation authority.
phase_policy.advisor_chat_r04_rule: Admin P-REV 5461318031 / Planner 5461353196: before R04 gate #178, the current public Dialogue experience must support a minimum usable free-text Advisor message/send/transcript flow, deterministic Local BOT protagonist interpretation/response, normalized non-binding influence states, and no-direct-control authority boundaries through #180/#181/#182/#248/#183. Full-body dialogue art, deep memory/trust, persistent instructions and external LLM integration remain later-phase work.
phase_policy.persistence_rule: Deterministic unchanged base content may be regenerated from SEED/coordinates; authoritative campaign changes are persisted and composed with chronology/hierarchical history.
phase_policy.real_time_rule: Campaign is real-time; at normal speed 60 real-world minutes equal one 24-hour in-game day.
phase_policy.calendar_origin_rule: New campaign fantasy day/month/time equal accepted civil origin while fantasy year = real year - 2000.
phase_policy.calendar_continuity_rule: After creation the fantasy chronology is its own accelerated authoritative timeline; elapsed real time advances it through bounded catch-up rather than re-synchronizing.
phase_policy.simulation_fidelity_rule: Active/relevant region uses high detail; nearby relevant state may be reduced-frequency/aggregate; far inactive detail should not continuously entity-tick.
phase_policy.hierarchical_simulation_rule: One authoritative world can be represented from global through realm, region, settlement and local layers using compact higher-level state.
phase_policy.relevance_bounded_simulation_rule: Invisible-world computation scales with relevance/required authoritative information, not total unbounded world size.
phase_policy.asynchronous_determinism_rule: Generation/catch-up/refinement/materialization should be async-capable where practical; scheduling/render/visit/device/order differences and stale results must not change authoritative outcomes.
phase_policy.lazy_materialization_rule: Inactive detail is materialized only when relevant from deterministic base plus authoritative chronology/history/persistence.
phase_policy.device_performance_rule: Current desktop browsers, phones and tablets are gameplay targets; presentation fidelity may scale but authoritative correctness may not.
phase_policy.character_art_direction_rule: Original mature seinen-anime-inspired language with believable proportions, grounded silhouettes/materials, restrained expression and clear status/profession/culture distinction; no protected-style copying.
phase_policy.character_identity_png_rule: Gameplay-relevant characters preserve recognizable identity across full-body static PNG dialogue forms and matching simplified living-map icons. Static PNG is sufficient; assets never create authoritative facts.
phase_policy.old_school_rpg_visual_rule: Old-school PC RPG world/UI framing with modern accessibility, responsive layouts and mobile/tablet performance.
phase_policy.visual_cohesion_rule: Characters, icons, environments, settlements and UI should read as one coherent product family.
phase_policy.strategic_scale_view_rule: Later strategic views summarize the same authoritative living-world hierarchy.
phase_policy.npc_life_rule: NPC routines may be time/location/role aware; ambient NPC dialogue may vary deterministically without becoming authoritative truth by itself.
phase_policy.ecology_rule: Domestic animals, wildlife and original medieval-fantasy creatures are SEED/habitat/context-aware where gameplay-relevant.
phase_policy.designer_rule: Every phase requires at least one independently testable Designer-role task before normal phase completion.
phase_policy.tester_deadlock_rule: Normal phase/release verification uses an independent Worker; only a documented all-identities cumulative deadlock may use DEADLOCK TESTER PASS under README conditions.
phase_policy.normal_phase_transition_rule: R05 does not activate until R04 gate #178 passes under normal independence or the documented cumulative deadlock exception.
